summary: Get certified as an ISO 50001 Lead Auditor and gain the skills to audit energy management systems (EnMS) effectively. Boost your career and ensure compliance
audienceIntro: This course is designed for energy and sustainability professionals who need to demonstrate competence in ISO 50001 energy management system auditing through a recognized PECB certification.
modules: Energy Management Systems Foundation and ISO 50001 Framework
Audit Principles and Stage 1 Audit Planning
Stage 2 Audit Execution and Evidence Gathering
Audit Reporting and Corrective Action Management
prerequisites: A fundamental understanding of ISO 50001 and comprehensive knowledge of audit principles.
